lastReasons: NEIGH 0.15 < 0.3: too few distinct words touch the LEGO. Give it different left and right neighbours across the basket.
JUNCT 0.20 < 0.5: the same neighbour pair repeats. Change what comes immediately before AND after the LEGO together.

分ける準備はできてた

rows.target_text: 二人とも帰る準備はできてたとは思わなかった

rows.known_text: were you prepared to take them there?
rows.target_text: 連れて行く準備はできてた
